name: Pledged to a Princess
source:
Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva has a secret. She spends most of her time online, talking to her best friend, Audrey, about the popular anime series Elf Forest, but Katarina (known to her friends as Katya) is more than an ordinary girl. She is, in fact, a princess: the future ruler of the small, little-known country of Lebedová.

One day, when talking to Audrey, Katya lets slip that she's a princess, and she invites Audrey to come and stay with her in Lebedová's royal palace during the winter holidays.

Audrey, an ordinary girl from Wales, is stunned by this reveal, but she eventually comes around to it. What girl wouldn't want to take an all-expenses paid holiday to a foreign country and live in a palace?

After a year of being friends online, Katya and Audrey finally meet face to face - but how will their relationship develop?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934280/Pledged_to_a_Princess/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
卡塔琳娜·米哈伊洛夫娜·瓦西里耶娃有一个秘密。她大部分时间都在网上与她最好的朋友奥黛丽谈论流行的动漫系列《精灵森林》，但卡塔琳娜（她的朋友们称为卡蒂亚）不仅仅是一个普通的女孩。事实上，她是一位公主：鲜为人知的列别多瓦小国未来的统治者。

有一天，在与奥黛丽交谈时，卡蒂亚无意中透露了自己是一位公主，并邀请奥黛丽寒假期间来列别多娃的皇宫和她一起住。

奥黛丽是一个来自威尔士的普通女孩，她对这一发现感到震惊，但她最终还是接受了现实。哪个女孩不想去异国享受全费用带薪假期并住在宫殿里？

在网上成为朋友一年后，卡蒂亚和奥黛丽终于面对面见面了 - 但他们的关系将如何发展？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934280/Pledged_to_a_Princess/]Steam[/url]]
